text:
kelsey: quick sync — PR #57999 is up for review. It touches orch routing + fallback policy + a small eviction config tweak. Need runtime, infra, and security sign-offs before I merge. Targeting tomorrow 06:00 UTC merge window. @sam-runtime @ajay-infra @jen-security can you please take a look? CI is currently pending.

sam-runtime: looking now. main questions: does this change any hot-path token handling or KV cache behavior? if so, need a short perf check.

kelsey: good Q — no hot-path model code changes. this only updates routing rules and an eviction bucket threshold from 0.75 -> 0.65. KV cache TTLs unchanged. Perf impact should be negligible but i can run a quick perf-run against canary if you want.

ajay-infra: noted. i need to see the eviction config diff and how it lands in the infra config map. also: does this require a rolling restart of the worker pool? if so we should schedule a staggered rollout.

kelsey: it patches the runtime-config CM and we have a rolling restart handler. rollout plan in PR description. No coordinated full-pool restart, just a per-deployment restart. i added a brief rollback snippet in the PR:

```bash
# rollback: revert configmap and restart deployments
kubectl apply -f runtime-config-old.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-worker -n inference
```

jen-security: skimmed — primary concerns: any new secrets, KMS access, or path that could expose model metadata? also need a short blurb on threat model for the fallback policy (how fallback is selected, logs, and opt-out).

kelsey: no new secrets or KMS changes. fallback selection is policy-based: pref->cost then latency, with prefer-safe-model flag for enterprise tenants. logging is already emitted to audit logs (config keys in PR). i'll add a 2–3 line threat model comment to the PR.

maria-platform: is there a canary plan? if stable we can give a soft-LGTMs and let runtime/infrastructure confirm before merge. otherwise hold until canary completes.

kelsey: canary plan posted in PR: 5% traffic for 2 hours, metric watchlist: p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rate. rollback if p95 increases >10% or error rate >0.5%. I'll trigger canary after approvals.

sam-runtime: sounds fine. i'll run a quick smoke perf job against canary once it's up. tagging :eyes: on the PR.

ajay-infra: i can give infra + restart procedural sign-off after i confirm the configmap patch doesn't change labels/selector behavior. should be able to sign off today.

jen-security: once you add the threat model blurb and confirm no new KMS scopes i'll give a security thumbs up.

kelsey: thanks all — i'll update PR with the threat model and the exact canary cron. pinging again once updated. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI status for PR #57999 — build: passed, unit-tests: passed, e2e: queued (estimated 12m).
